use_when: to take people to another page, such as “View all books”
to take people to another part of the same page
inside a sentence, where a full button would be too heavy

dont_use_when.when: for the main action on a screen.
for an action that changes data, such as “Add to cart”.
with long text. Keep the label short and clear.

best_practice: Use short link text that says where the link goes, such as "View all books".
Don't use "click here" or "read more" on their own.
Keep the underline, so links don't depend on color alone.

variant_intent.type=With icon: Link with a leading and/or trailing icon (code).
variant_intent.state=Default: Lets hover, focus and visited happen naturally (code).
variant_intent.state=Hover: Pins the hover look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Visited: Pins the visited look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Disable: Makes the link inert: no href, aria-disabled, not focusable (code).

a11y.fact: Renders a native <a>; keyboard users reach it with Tab when it has an href.
A disabled link drops its href and sets aria-disabled, so it is not focusable or followable.
Shows a focus outline on keyboard focus.
